name: Maxim Krongauz
evidence: Identified as Maxim Anisimovich Krongauz, Dr. of Philology, professor at HSE University and head of HSE's Research and Study Laboratory for Linguistic Conflictology, co-author of this row's paper. WebSearch returned his official HSE person page (https://www.hse.ru/org/persons/147023822), Wikipedia and Gramota.ru profiles; the results printed only his office phone (+7 (495) 772-95-90 ext. 22699) and postal address, and the search explicitly did not confirm any email. hse.ru is egress-blocked here so the person page could not be opened. GitHub code search for '"Krongauz" "@" in:file' returned only namesakes: David Krongauz (Weizmann/voice-biomarker papers) and Y. Krongauz (meshfree-methods bibliography) - different people, excluded by the namesake rule. No address appeared verbatim anywhere retrieved.
